refused.said: There is a grue here, in the light, in plain sight, which no grue has ever been or ever would be: it has the lamp-lit, slightly transparent look of something the Wizard thought of. A real one would have had you by now. It was never there: the Wizard's word put it in the room, and the room, having no say in the matter, let it, and has the grace to look embarrassed about it now.

You look, and look again, and your eye closes on nothing, and the harder you look the less there is. It was never there: the Wizard's word put it in the room, and the room, having no say in the matter, let it, and has the grace to look embarrassed about it now.
You are frozen solid. You might as well wait it out, because you can't do anything else in this state.
